title: turfc --version --json, the interface manifest
description: What a tool checks before relying on a turfc flag or format (IF-1). Manifest 1: keys are only added, never changed or removed; a feature name, once listed, keeps its meaning.

turfc.description: The release version, as line 1 of `turfc --version` prints it.

interface.description: The driver interface, as line 2 of `turfc --version` prints it.

features.description: One name per addition to the driver interface, then what this build has: smart, embedded-lld, bundled-runtime.
